name: Ecobee (web OAuth reference)
description: Reference Ecobee web OAuth recipe using the generic protected sign-in browser. Unofficial public web client; real account login and thermostat commands are not yet verified.

auth.setup: Connect in the protected sign-in browser and complete Ecobee's own login/MFA pages. The public web client ID and callback come from python-ecobee-api, not a Morph registration. Provider policy, embedded-browser support and these narrower scopes may change or be rejected; do not claim success without real login. No password belongs in app code or chat. Tokens are private host storage. An ID token, if returned, is ignored; this is not OpenID identity verification.

permissions: Change thermostat comfort holds using smartWrite
Keep a private renewable account session using offline_access
docs: REFERENCE ONLY: login and commands require real-account testing. Sources: https://github.com/nkgilley/python-ecobee-api/blob/master/pyecobee/const.py and __init__.py; https://www.ecobee.com/home/developer/api/documentation/v1/functions/SetHold.shtml . This uses a public Ecobee web client, not an official Morph partnership or developer-registration bypass guarantee. Open a new instance with plugins.open('ecobee',{slot:'personal'}) and connect only in protected setup. Use its INSTANCE ID. All calls use request({url,method?,body?}). List thermostats: GET https://api.ecobee.com/1/thermostat?format=json&json= plus encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({selection:{selectionType:'registered',selectionMatch:'',includeRuntime:true,includeProgram:true,includeEvents:true}})). Inspect API-level status.code as well as HTTP success; nonzero is a service error. Home/Away: POST https://api.ecobee.com/1/thermostat?format=json with body {selection:{selectionType:'thermostats',selectionMatch:thermostatId},functions:[{type:'setHold',params:{holdClimateRef:'home',holdType:'nextTransition'}}]}. Use holdClimateRef:'away' for Away; holdType:'indefinite' for an explicitly chosen indefinite hold. Read available climate references from the thermostat program; do not assume every account uses the same references. Resume schedule: same POST endpoint with functions:[{type:'resumeProgram',params:{resumeAll:true}}]. Do not silently send writes to every thermostat; select a real thermostat ID. Keep the UI to the user's requested Home/Away controls plus necessary connection/status/thermostat selection. Never expose credentials, cookies or tokens. Existing instances stay pinned to their recipe release; changed auth needs a new slot. The auth scopes deliberately omit the upstream library's piiWrite/piiRead/deleteGrants scopes; do not automatically escalate if the provider rejects these narrower scopes.

request.description: Bounded JSON calls to the fixed Ecobee API with private Bearer injection; check response status.code.
